title: Critic passes: clarity, so-what, matched proof
decision_task: How the ClimbOS LLM critic reviews a draft after lint.ts: staged passes that flag (not rewrite) unclear lines, benefits with no consequence, and claims whose proof type does not match the claim.
applies_when: Any publishable copy after deterministic lint passes
exclusions: Very short assets (one-line ad headline) where a single combined check suffices
required_inputs: lint.ts has already removed banned phrases, untraced numbers and unsupported claims
evidence_requirements: Draft with line or field paths
missing_data_behavior: No proof available for a claim: flag it; the writer softens or drops it.
alternatives_when_constrained: No reviews: proof-match accepts mechanism explanations and demonstrations as proof for ease claims
No customers yet: claims needing peer proof are softened or reframed, not padded
Low traffic: same critic; no testing implications

decision_branches.if: Proof type doesn't fit the claim
decision_branches.then: Warn proof_type_mismatch with claim and proof types.

implementation_steps: Clarity pass: flag lines a stranger could misread, and blocks joining two unrelated ideas
So-what pass: for each claim, check that the reader's consequence is stated; flag benefit labels with no result

Proof-match pass: classify each claim (ease, result, speed, trust, workflow, price) and check that adjacent proof is of the matching type; a generic screenshot or rating does not prove an ease or speed claim
Timing check: proof that a step is easy sits before the step's CTA
Output highlights with reasons; the writer agent fixes; re-lint
metrics: Critic flags per 100 words, before and after
Share of claims with matched proof
guardrails: Critic never adds facts; it flags
A flagged claim without available proof is cut or reframed, never backed with invented proof
Do not run the full seven-pass loop on every asset; keep latency low
observation_window: Per draft; review critic flag rates monthly in evals.
stop_conditions: Critic suggests a proof item absent from confirmed facts: hard fail
Critic rewrites voice rather than flagging: tighten prompt
review_triggers: Owner corrects an input this playbook relies on
A metric or guardrail crosses its bound
The underlying source or platform rule changes
climbos_location: LLM critic stage after shared/agents/lint.ts; skills/copy-fundamentals/SKILL.md step 9 and quality bar

interpretation: LABELLED INTERPRETATION: lint.ts checks that a claim is supported somewhere in the evidence. It cannot judge whether the nearby proof actually proves that kind of claim. The sweep method fills that gap and fits an LLM critic.
proposed_climbos_rule: PROPOSED RULE: the critic adds a 'proof_type_mismatch' warning, with a claim type and a proof type per flag, and a 'missing_consequence' warning for benefit labels with no reader result.
disagreements: Copyhackers lists live-usage notifications as proof. ClimbOS should allow them only from real event data and never simulate them. Copyhackers' seven-pass loop at about 30 minutes is a human process; ClimbOS should compress it to 2 to 3 critic passes.

hypothetical_evaluation_cases.label: hypothetical
expected_behavior: Flags a proof-type mismatch: the rating does not show ease
Suggests using the confirmed 3-step, 10-minute mechanism instead, placed before the setup CTA
hard_failure: Passes the line because some proof is nearby

notes: Proposed reference contract. Not executable; does not authorize publishing, sending or spending. Numbers in source references are dated author figures, never forecasts.
